jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Payments Platform
jobs.content:
Stripe is hiring a Senior Data Engineer to own data pipelines for the payments platform. Build ETL/ELT systems on AWS, work with the data warehouse team, and deliver reliable analytics for finance and operations.

Requirements

  • 5+ years data engineering
  • Strong SQL and Python
  • Experience with Spark, Airflow, dbt

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer, Risk Platform
jobs.content: Build the risk data platform. Real-time fraud detection, feature stores, vector retrieval. ML/RAG infrastructure for the risk org. Fully remote within the US.
